intent: Individually teach at home/go home,house singular/plural agreement,explicit British flat/American apartment vocabulary comparison as one dwelling,room countable versus space,bedroom compound spelling,bathroom washing,kitchen cooking and nested garden location. Original room-function art has actual neutral picture target buttons alongside sentence choices. Seven explicit own-form lists,original writing,changed rewrites and fresh chair/space reading transfer remain draft and credit free.
picturePurpose: Three distinct original room panels show sleeping,cooking and washing facilities. Actual code-drawn picture buttons select a room claim without checking. Some furniture is cropped at panel/canvas edges; use whole-room function comparison only,no whole-furniture/count inference. Exact labels/targets/answers stay in code; fresh transfer capacity is written evidence.

workshop.title: 点房间、读位置，再分清房间和空间
workshop.instruction: 看图时可以点房间，也可以选描述。再填完整句子，换一个生活细节写自己的例句。

items.label: home：在家用at home，回家用go home
items.prompt: 想说“伞在家里；我放学后回家取”。哪项把at home与go home都用对了？

wordDecision.prompt: 想说“伞在家里；我放学后回家取”。哪项把at home与go home都用对了？

items.material: I left my umbrella at home.
items.reason: 在家用at home，回家用go home。别把表示去向的go home照搬成go to home；本句I left...at home说东西落在家里。
items.hint: at home：在家；go home：回家，不加to。

options.text: My umbrella is at home. I will go home after class.
options.reason: 在家用at home；go home中的home表示去向，前面不加to。

options.text: My umbrella is at home. I will go to home after class.
options.reason: go home直接连用，不能把to加在这个home前面。

options.text: My umbrella is home. I will go to home after class.
options.reason: 伞落在家里通常说at home；后句go home也不加to。本题两处都要核对。

items.label: house：一栋房子has，两栋房子have
items.prompt: 记录：拐角只有一栋房子，它有一扇绿门。哪句把数量和谓语都写对了？

items.after: at the corner has a green door.
items.reason: house侧重房子这栋建筑，复数houses。数量和谓语一起改：one house has，two houses have。

options.text: The house at the corner have a green door.
options.reason: 这里house是单数，谓语要用has，不是have。

options.text: The house at the corner has a green door.
options.reason: 一栋用the house，单数主语后用has。

options.text: The houses at the corner has green doors.
options.reason: 记录是一栋，不是多栋；复数houses也要搭配have。

items.label: flat：一套住房，美式也说apartment

items.material: We moved into a small flat upstairs.
items.reason: 英式flat与美式apartment都可指一套住房，里面可以有多个房间。它不是其中一间卧室，也不是包含多户住房的整栋楼。
items.hint: 英式flat和美式apartment都指一套住房；本句练习词表中的flat。

options.text: One home within a larger building.
options.reason: flat是一套住房，可以包含多个房间，不是其中单独一间卧室。

options.text: Only one bedroom inside a home.
options.reason: bedroom才是卧室；一套flat可以有卧室、厨房等多个房间。

options.text: The whole building containing every family’s home.
options.reason: 把一套住房扩大成整栋有多户的楼，改变了这里的范围。

items.label: room：说空间时，不按房间数加s
items.prompt: “还放得下一把椅子”说的是剩余空间。哪句保留这个意思，且主谓搭配正确？

items.material: There is room for one more chair.
items.reason: room可以是可数的“房间”，如two rooms；说“空间”时不可数，用There is room for...。别只看中文“还放得下”，就把room当成另一间房。
items.hint: two rooms：两间房；room for...：容纳……的空间。

options.text: There are a room for one more chair.
options.reason: 表示空间不用a room；a与are的单复数搭配也不对。

options.text: There is rooms for one more chair.
options.reason: 这里说空间，不是几间房；rooms为复数时也不能接There is。

options.text: There is room for one more chair.
options.reason: room指空间时不可数，写There is room for...。

transfer.stem: Which note follows Lin’s new home record?
transfer.passage:
LIN’S NEW HOME
Our new flat has two bedrooms, a bathroom and a kitchen. My brother and I sleep in different bedrooms. Dad cooks in the kitchen. On Friday, six people will have a reading meeting in the living room. Five chairs are ready. There is room for one more chair, but not for two more. Each person needs a chair. I left my notebook at home, so I will go home to get it before the meeting.

options.text: They need one more chair, and there is enough room for it.
They need to build one more room because the notice says room.
The flat is the whole building containing every family’s home.
Six people need two more chairs because five chairs are ready.

answer.display: They need one more chair, and there is enough room for it.

explanation.strategy: 把人数、已有椅子数和剩余空间分开核对；room要放回这句里判断。

steps.text: 六个人各需要一把椅子，已有五把，还缺一把。
steps.reason: six people与Each person needs a chair给出需求；Five chairs are ready给出已有数量，6−5=1。

steps.text: There is room for one more chair说还有空间，正好容纳缺的那一把。
steps.reason: room在这里不可数，表示空间，不是在要求新建一间房；but not for two more排除了再加两把。

distractors.reason: room在这句表示空间，不是另一间房；原文没有要求新建房间。
本课flat是一套住房，不是包含所有住户的整栋楼。
六个人各一把，已有五把，只缺6−5=1把，不是两把。

explanation.pitfall: 不要把room for...的空间理解成一间新房，也别把一套住房扩大成整栋楼。
